simple.meaning: שָׁבַץ (shâbats) is a Hebrew word meaning “to interweave (colored) threads in squares; by implication ( of reticulation ) to inchase gems in gold.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שָׁבַץ (H7660) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 28:20, with occurrences in Exodus.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁבַץ (H7660) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שָׁבַץ (H7660) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שָׁבַץ (shâbats) / H7660 is traced through Exodus 28:20, Exodus 28:39 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: to interweave (colored) threads in squares; by implication ( of reticulation ) to inchase gems in gold
definitions.full: H7660. shabats [ שָׁבַץ ] verb Pi`el probably weave in chequer or plaited work (Late Hebrew שָׁבַץ ornament a vessel with a pattern ; Syriac (Lexicons) immiscuit , commixtio: see also Lag BN 143 ); — Pi`el Perfect 2masculine singular וְשִׁבַּצְתָּ֫ Exod 28:39 (P), and thou shalt chequer (or plait) the tunic (in) byssus. Pu`al Participle masculine plural זָהָב מְשֻׁבָּצִים Exod 28:20 (P), inwoven (i.e. set in a chequered or plaited mounting) with gold (-thread) shall they be (of gems).

occurrences.englishText: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.
You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.
